# PurelyCleaningServices

> Trusted, vetted home cleaning service based in Dubai, UAE. Premium service standards, eco-friendly and non-toxic products used as standard, transparent pricing with no hidden fees.

PurelyCleaningServices offers residential home cleaning across Dubai, covering studios, apartments, townhouses, and villas.

## Services
- Regular Cleaning: weekly or fortnightly recurring home maintenance
- Deep Cleaning: thorough top-to-bottom cleaning
- Holiday Home Turnover: fast cleaning between short-term rental guests
- Move-In / Move-Out Cleaning: handover-ready cleaning for tenants and landlords
- Post-Renovation Cleaning: dust and debris removal after construction or renovation work

## Recurring Plans
Weekly, fortnightly, twice-weekly, and monthly recurring cleaning plans are available, with savings of up to 12% (fortnightly), 20% (weekly) and 25% (twice weekly).

## New customer offers (until 26 Oct 2026)
- Apartments (studio, 1 and 2 bedroom): first clean from AED 79
- Townhouses and villas: first clean from AED 149
- New customers only, one use per customer, regular cleaning only, extra time billed at AED 50/hr

- Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Coverage area: all of Dubai
